payload.summary: The incident involves a brute force attack on the account 'jdoe' from the IP address '10.66.0.10', which resulted in a successful login after 24 failed attempts. The source IP has no prior successful login history, and there is no documented change that explains this activity.

attack_chain.description: The attacker used brute force to guess the password of the account 'jdoe' from the IP address '10.66.0.10', resulting in a successful login after 24 failed attempts.

risk_factors: Brute force attack on an account
Successful login after multiple failed attempts from an unknown source IP

proposed_actions.justification: The account 'jdoe' was successfully logged into after a brute force attack, indicating a potential compromise.
